Package org.jdesktop.lg3d.wg

Class Component3DAnimationTarget

java.lang.Object
org.jdesktop.lg3d.wg.Component3DAnimationTarget
All Implemented Interfaces:
AnimationTarget
Direct Known Subclasses:
Frame3DAnimationTarget
public class Component3DAnimationTarget extends Object implements AnimationTarget
Animation Target for the Component3D animations, only a single Component3DAnimationTarget can be active at any one time per Component, the system will enforce this policy. Objects of this class are managed internally to this package.
